# authwise_guard_relay_pools (Data Source)

An estate relay pool: a named set of relays shared across networks and tenants. Operators only. `select` orders the pool's relays for a node, `served-order` (priority, then display name; the default) or `nearest` (by the node's `region`). `default` makes it the estate default pool: every tenant may use it, and it is the default of a tenant without its own (`authwise_guard_relay_pool_access.default_pool`). Setting it on one pool clears it on the previous default. A pool in use is not deleted (`RELAY_POOL_IN_USE`): remove it from networks and from tenants' access first. This data source lists every one under a parent.
